Treat the 20 eV electron non-relativistically, since 20 eV is much less than its rest energy of 511 keV.
E = 20 × 1.6e-19 = 3.2e-18 J.
Electron: p_e = √(2mE) = √(2 × 9e-31 × 3.2e-18) = √(5.76e-48) = 2.4e-24 kg·m/s.
Photon: p_ph = E/c = 3.2e-18 / 3e8 = 1.067e-26 kg·m/s.
Ratio: p_e/p_ph = 2.4e-24 / 1.067e-26 = 225.
